ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B1-1,
Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 28-F in
the area bound by:

West 113' Street; South Wentworth Avenue; a line 48 feet south of and parallel to West
113" Street; and the alley next west of and parallel to South Wentworth Avenue,

to those of a RS-2, Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

iff Cut Bowl

Anthony A. Beale
Alderman, 9° Ward

Common Address:
11300 S. Wentworth Avenue
